leaveTitle: Leave before the rename is saved?
leaveMessage: The new title has not reached the server yet. Leaving now loses it.

reloaded.rejected: Someone else saved first, so this document was reloaded from the server. Anything you had typed in the last moment was replaced.
reloaded.diverged: A change arrived that could not be merged with yours, so this document was reloaded from the server. Anything you had typed in the last moment was replaced.

offline.connecting: Connecting to the live session. Editing is paused until it is ready.
offline.stalled: No live connection, so editing is paused. Reconnecting in the background — nothing you have written is lost.
